Container.Name: Strata
Container.Overview:
Strata runs the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next mixture-of-experts model on one NVIDIA GPU plus system RAM, and serves an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API, a chat page and a live monitor.
Requirements: the Nvidia Driver plugin on driver 580 or newer; an RTX 20/30/40/50 card with 12 GB of VRAM or more; an AVX2 CPU; 48-62 GB of free RAM depending on the model; 70-90 GB of disk on an SSD pool.
First start: downloads the model (about 70 GB for IQ2_XS) and sets it up, which can take a few hours. Watch the log; it resumes if it stops. Later starts go straight to serving, and loading the model into RAM takes 1-3 minutes.
Changing settings later: switching Model or Model family needs nothing extra. Changing context, vision, KV cache, API key or low-RAM mode for a model already set up needs Reinstall = 1 for one start (nothing is downloaded again), then set it back to 0.
No API key by default: anyone who can reach the port can use the model. Keep it LAN-only, or set an API key.
This is an unofficial image built from Strata's own Dockerfile. Report template or image problems at the Support link, not to the Strata project.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: llm qwen local ai openai anthropic api inference chat nvidia cuda gpu
Container.Requires: **Nvidia Driver plugin** on driver 580 or newer. Do not pin CPUs: the engine sets its own thread affinity and breaks inside a cpuset. Do not set a memory limit unless Low-RAM mode is on.

Config.Name: WebUI / API port
Config.Description: Chat page, monitor and the /v1 API. No API key is set by default, so keep this LAN-only.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The model, the prepared pack, the MTP layer and the install config: 70-90 GB depending on the model. Use a direct pool path (/mnt/cache/... or /mnt/POOLNAME/...), not /mnt/user: the engine reads experts from these files while it runs.

Config.Name: GPU
Config.Description: Your card's UUID (GPU-xxxxxxxx-...) from the Nvidia Driver plugin page or nvidia-smi -L. Name one card; 'all' on a two-card server makes setup split the model across both.

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: IQ2_XS (recommended): 68 GB download, 48 GB RAM. Q2_0: fastest, 48 GB RAM (qwen only). IQ3_XXS: better, 60 GB RAM. IQ3_S: best quality, 62 GB RAM. IQ1_M: coder family only, 32 GB RAM. UD-Q4_K_XL: unsloth family only.

Config.Name: Model family
Config.Description: qwen (default); swift (thinks shorter); coder (for code, fewer experts); unsloth and nvfp4 need their own models (see Model).

Config.Name: Context length
Config.Description: Tokens per conversation. Longer costs RAM; setup caps it if the RAM is short. Changing it for a model already set up needs Reinstall = 1.

Config.Name: Vision
Config.Description: Image input: yes runs the image encoder on the GPU, cpu runs it on the CPU. Changing it for a model already set up needs Reinstall = 1.

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Empty = no key. When set, /v1/* requires it as Authorization: Bearer or x-api-key; /health and the chat page stay open. Setting or changing it for a model already set up needs Reinstall = 1.

Config.Name: Reinstall
Config.Description: 1 = run setup again on the next start to apply changed context, vision, KV cache, API key or low-RAM settings. Nothing is downloaded again. Set it back to 0 afterwards.

Config.Name: KV cache type
Config.Description: int8 (default); q4_0 halves the KV memory, slightly less precise; k8v4 keeps its KV in VRAM from 64K context up. Needs Reinstall = 1 to change.

Config.Name: Low-RAM mode
Config.Description: on maps the experts from the pack on disk instead of keeping them in RAM. Required if you give the container a memory limit: setup sees the server's total RAM, not the limit. Needs Reinstall = 1 to change.

Config.Name: NVIDIA driver capabilities
Config.Description: Must include utility: setup needs nvidia-smi.
